actions.description: Create a new OCI Compute instance. Defaults to VM.Standard.E2.1.Micro (always-free eligible). Rollback: terminate.

parameters.name: compartment_id
parameters.description: OCID of target compartment; resolved from asset metadata

parameters.name: subnet_id
parameters.description: OCID of subnet; auto-resolved from compartment if omitted

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: quick | spec

parameters.name: os
parameters.description: oracle_linux | ubuntu

parameters.name: image_id
parameters.description: Explicit image OCID (spec mode); auto-resolved in quick mode

parameters.name: key_pair_id
parameters.description: Nexplane key_pair asset ID

parameters.name: ssh_public_key
parameters.description: Raw SSH public key string

parameters.description: Backup display name; defaults to nexplane-snapshot-<timestamp>

parameters.name: backup_type
parameters.description: INCREMENTAL | FULL

Remove an inbound or outbound rule from an OCI Security List.

Remove a rule from an OCI NSG by rule ID or matching parameters.

Create a listener on an OCI Load Balancer.

Remove all group memberships and delete an OCI IAM user.

Remove all memberships and delete an OCI IAM group.

Delete an OCI IAM policy.

Create a manual backup of an OCI Autonomous Database.

parameters.name: repository_id
parameters.description: OCID of the repository

actions.description: Permanently deletes a container image by OCID. Irreversible — image layer data cannot be recovered.

parameters.name: image_id
parameters.description: OCID of the container image

actions.description: Restores an OCI Autonomous Database to a point-in-time or from a specific backup. Irreversible — overwrites current DB state.

parameters.name: autonomous_database_id
parameters.description: OCID of the ADB to restore

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: ISO8601 point-in-time timestamp

parameters.name: backup_id
parameters.description: OCID of a specific backup to restore from (alternative to timestamp)

parameters.name: boot_volume_backup_id
parameters.description: OCID of the boot volume backup
